provenance.sdk: typesafe_sdk (version not published on these pages); fixtures are the documented wire examples, not captured SDK output
notes: Only the text subset Muse supports: string state/instructions, string or null criteria descriptions.
TypeSafe also accepts structured (object/array) instructions and criteria; Muse rejects them.
Muse requires an explicit catalog `model`; the documented requests omit it, so the tests add one.
Documented probabilities are rounded to 2 decimals and their answer keys are not always in request order; Muse keeps request order and full precision.
Documented usage.output_tokens is nonzero; Muse reports 0 because it scores candidates without generating.
